findings.problem: 'Popped on the first verification attempt, so one assertion serves one decision' holds only for the newest cookie: the session is client-side, an old copy still has the challenge; synced passkeys report sign_count 0, so py_webauthn does not catch the replay. test_step_up_is_used_once accepts 403 or 409, and 409 comes from the DB one-vote rule, so it passes without the pop. No extra decision is possible (challenge bound to intent+hash, one vote per human).
findings.required_improvement: Correct the docstring/README claim (one vote per human is enforced by the DB; an assertion replayed within 5 min gives no new decision); in the test use a zero-counter authenticator and assert 409 and exactly one decision.
